create_racecar_gym_env: create a RacecarGymEnv with renders enabled and discrete or continuous action space
reset_racecar_environment: reset the racecar gym environment to its initial state before stepping
add_debug_parameter_slider: add a user debug parameter slider for wheel velocity or steering control
step_racecar_environment: step the racecar environment with a continuous or discrete action and get state reward done info
get_extended_observation: get the extended observation from the racecar environment after stepping
